releaseNotes:
Planning is back — set a monthly Needs, Wants, and Savings budget and see how you’re tracking.

Home is clearer: money in, money out, and net, plus your budget at a glance. Transfers between your own accounts no longer look like income.

Transactions now group by day with category icons. Reports lead with spending by category. Settings is easier to scan.

Jump around with the new bar at the bottom. Open the menu for Planning and Settings.
